summary: Frontend UI Testing for Dedicated Payment Page - All requested features verified successfully. Payment page is portal-specific with orange theme for Orange Pharmacy and green theme for Mango Health Labs. Order summary correctly displays customer name, phone, and items from URL params. All three payment options (Cash on Delivery, Pay Later with 'Recommended' badge, Pay Now) are selectable. Confirm Order button is properly disabled until a payment method is selected.
test_credentials: No authentication required for payment page testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment page feature is complete and working. Tested both Orange Pharmacy (/payment?type=pharmacy) and Mango Health Labs (/payment?type=mango) variations.

features_tested.feature: Orange Pharmacy payment page renders with orange theme at /payment?type=pharmacy
features_tested.details: Header shows 'Orange Pharmacy' with package icon. Orange gradient header (from-orange-500 to-orange-600). Orange styling applied throughout including border and selection states.

features_tested.feature: Mango Labs payment page renders with green theme at /payment?type=mango
features_tested.details: Header shows 'Mango Health Labs' with flask icon. Green gradient header (from-green-600 to-green-700). Green styling applied throughout. Shows 'Home Collection' in Order Summary for lab bookings.

features_tested.feature: Order Summary displays customer name, phone, items from URL params
features_tested.details: Customer name, phone number, and items list are correctly parsed from URL params and displayed in Order Summary card. Medicines shown for pharmacy, Tests shown for Mango Labs. Preferred Date and Collection type displayed for Mango bookings.

features_tested.feature: Three payment options (Cash on Delivery, Pay Later, Pay Now) are selectable
features_tested.details: All three payment options displayed with unique icons (Banknote, Clock, CreditCard). Each option has data-testid attributes. Options show appropriate subtitles: 'Pay when you receive your medicines' for pharmacy COD vs 'Pay at the time of sample collection' for Mango Labs COD.
'Recommended' badge displayed as blue pill (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700) next to Pay Later option title.

features_tested.feature: Confirm Order button exists and is disabled until payment method selected
features_tested.details: Button with data-testid='confirm-payment-btn' found. Button is disabled (greyed out, not clickable) when no payment method selected. Button becomes enabled with full gradient styling after selecting any payment option.

features_tested.feature: Portal-specific header shows correct portal name
features_tested.details: Header dynamically shows 'Orange Pharmacy' or 'Mango Health Labs' based on type URL parameter. Correct icon (Package vs FlaskConical) displayed.

features_tested.feature: Back button exists and is functional
features_tested.details: Back button with data-testid='back-btn' found in header. Uses navigate(-1) to go back in browser history.
